Description: Audio Object Editing: creates and composes Audio Objects, and edits their properties. One object is open at a time, so no User Command names its target. BASIC AND FULL ARE EXPLICIT: which Port delivered says whether a Basic Audio Object or a composed Audio Object is being edited, and the corresponding output Port says which kind was produced - the executor routes by Data Type, so a distinction left implicit in the data would have to be recovered by inspecting it. Opening is done by Port; creation opens implicitly. Acting is done by User Command, one per user action.
